title: Faithful Gather to Welcome Pope Leo Back for Sunday Blessing After Cancer Surgery
detail: Faithful gathered to welcome Pope Leo back for the Sunday blessing, his first such appearance since lung cancer surgery, per a news aggregator report. Details not independently confirmed.

title: Pope's Brother Says Family Awaits Biopsy Results After Lung Cancer Surgery
detail: The Pope's brother said the family is awaiting biopsy results following the lung cancer surgery, per a news aggregator report. Not independently confirmed by the Holy See.
